apps.name: 1BITDRAGON
apps.short_description: Create Music for Your Game: make loop-perfect, royalty-free tracks without a DAW, plugins, or music theory.

apps.name: AuxPipe
apps.short_description: Play Spotify, YouTube or game audio through your microphone in Discord, Zoom, Teams or OBS, and talk over it. AuxPipe mixes one app's sound with your voice. The virtual cable is included.

apps.name: Crosshairs
apps.short_description: Put a custom crosshair over your windowed or borderless game with a lightweight Windows overlay. Browse 20,000 PNG and animated GIF variants, fine-tune vector presets, or draw your own. Warm up with six 2D aim drills and a 3D shooting range.

apps.name: GameStack
apps.short_description:
GameStack puts everything you need to make a game in one app: a design
  doc and task board, a pixel art and animation editor, a low-poly modeler with on-model painting, a retro sound
  effect maker, and live sync into Unity.

apps.name: HiFi Streamer Pro
apps.short_description: HiFi Streamer Pro is a lightweight, high-fidelity audio engine for audiophiles. Stream bit-perfect music from local drives or Plex Media Servers using WASAPI Exclusive mode. Features a 10-band EQ,   scrobbling, and a highly customizable, skinnable mini-player to keep your desktop clean.

apps.name: Naia - Visual AI Agent
apps.short_description: Naia is a visual agent on your PC that remembers you and works alongside you. With a face, a voice, long-term memory, and a workspace, it doesn't just chat — it actually organizes files, searches, and codes with you. Sign up for free credits, and local AI is completely free.

apps.name: Phase Pal: AI Desktop Assistant
apps.short_description: An animated AI companion for your desktop. Pick them up, toss them around, or give them a window seat. Chat by text or voice, set reminders, check Gmail, get help on screen, and bring your Pal into Minecraft. Run local AI offline or connect online.

apps.name: picoCAD
apps.short_description: A tiny modeler for tiny models! Unleash your creativity in retro 3D and find a fun, easy, and accessible way into 3D modelling by focusing on the bare essentials.

apps.name: Pixelify
apps.short_description: Pixelify your illustrations, add your own finishing touches, and create pixel art in moments!

apps.name: R Engine™
apps.short_description: Create your own 3D & 2D RPG without writing code. Paint worlds, build towns, script events with visual nodes, design characters and monsters, and export your game to Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS — from turn-based classics to survival horror.

apps.name: SeizeControl
apps.short_description: A power-user file explorer with a unique chat-style folder view and a plugin platform. Navigate your files and extend with plugins, from overlays and macros to whatever you build or find. Browse, share, and download plugins on the Steam Workshop.

apps.name: VRoid Studio
apps.short_description: VRoid Studio is a 3D character creation software developed for you to freely express yourself, even without 3D modeling expertise. The software is easy-to-use. Even first-time users can fully enjoy the software by picking preset items and playing around with the parameters’ sliders.

apps.name: WinGrid
apps.short_description: Zoom into any game instantly in windowed or borderless mode—without sacrificing FPS. Plus custom resolutions, black bars, hotkeys, and more.

apps.name: ANDALAS : Realms of Eternal Lights Playtest
Izakaya Diaries - Sushi Restaurant Simulator Playtest
The Demon Wants to Marry the Princess or Lose Her at Poker Playtest
The Sky Project: Land of Noris Playtest
Vug: From Caves to Stars Playtest
A Thousand Years Demo
apps.short_description: A real time strategy game in which you manage small parties of angels and devils. Equip units and watch them auto-battle in a procedurally generated world.

apps.name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero Demo
apps.short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable factions.

apps.name: Altered Alma Demo
apps.short_description: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cyberpunk cityscape, Neo Barcelona awaits!

apps.name: Animal Zone Demo
apps.short_description: Animal zone is a fast and furious one-shot one-kill 2D shooter game. Make headshots, tear your opponents to pieces, and stay alive to take your place in the food chain! Face off against your friends in this brutal animal world.

apps.name: Aster League 2179 Demo
apps.short_description: Aster League 2179 is a Crash Team Racing inspired spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

apps.name: B.C. Piezophile Demo
apps.short_description: The B.C. Piezophile Demo is an open mecha sandbox designed for the player to familiarize them sylfs with the normal handling procedures of the Strategic Force Multiplying Unit as overseen by the Mercy Envoy Atta’s Council of Esteemed Leapers.

apps.name: Backrooms Fishing Demo
apps.short_description: Idle and catch mysterious creatures lurking in the Poolrooms. Upgrade your fishing equipment, research bizarre specimens, and build your collection as you uncover the secrets of the Backrooms. Every catch will bring you closer to understanding this strange realm.

apps.name: Beekeeper Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Beekeeper Simulator puts you in the shoes of a dedicated beekeeper, where you'll care for buzzing hives, harvest a variety of honey types, and expand your operations to build a thriving beekeeping empire. Nurture your bees, optimize your apiary, and turn your passion into profit!

apps.name: Bilingual Crosswords Demo
apps.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

apps.name: Blast Project Demo
apps.short_description: A 2D action platformer inspired by the old greats like MegaMan X and Contra. Battle your way through the robot horde, with classic platformer levels and high speed shoot-em-up style stages

apps.name: Blue Dimension: Save the Game Demo
apps.short_description: Stop them before they take all the PCs! You are the last defense as the digital dimension collapses. In this fast-paced Action FPS, shred enemies, harvest their souls to grow stronger, and master rocket jumps to survive brutal platforming. Can you crash the system and save the last PC?

apps.name: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy Demo
apps.short_description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true Chess Master!

apps.name: BOT.vinnik Chess: USSR vs the World Demo
Bullet Meltdown Demo
apps.short_description: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.

apps.name: BULLETHEART Demo
apps.short_description: Learn the layouts, master the mechanics, and optimize your bullet usage to achieve victory in BULLETHEART. Augment yourself with powerful upgrades and eliminate enemies with style.

apps.name: Champion Trainer Demo
apps.short_description: Play a full year of Champion Trainer, the forthcoming flat racing management sim. Race from the winter all-weather to the summer's big meets across 24 real UK/IRE tracks, and breed from genuine lineages 300 years deep, with Chef-de-Race dosage, Bruce Lowe families and nicks from real race records.

apps.name: Climb, Cube, Climb! Demo
apps.short_description: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a hybrid rage game and precision platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.

apps.name: Contested Space: Core Defender Demo
apps.short_description: The first pack opening defense game demo where you can play with friends! Crack booster packs to build your fleet, defend your core, and aim your own cannon while your stations fire. 1-4 player online co-op, short runs, hundreds of unlocks. Set in the Contested Space universe.

apps.name: Cut The Grass: Farm Defense Survival Demo
apps.short_description: Get a first taste of survival in Cut The Grass. In this demo, you’ll experience a few in-game days of base defense, try out basic weapons, and unlock your first upgrades as you fight to hold back the night.

apps.name: Dark Journey to the West Demo
apps.short_description: A dark-themed idle loot game. Gather and train minions and artifacts with distinct abilities — then pit your builds against legendary bosses. Lead your monster squad through the Heavenly Palace, the Underworld, the sacred mountains, and beyond, all in search of the true scriptures.

apps.name: Decadent Heir Demo
apps.short_description: Rewrite history in this narrative RPG set in the twilight of Imperial Russia. Born into nobility, shape your destiny and the fate of a nation. Will you uphold the old order, lead the revolution, or forge your own path? Every choice has consequences. Your decisions will echo through time.

apps.name: Definitely Safe Demo
apps.short_description: Put rockets together from scrap parts, pack the powder, cut the fuse and see what happens. Film every flight. Upload your footage, chase views, and climb the charts. Totally legal. Definitely safe.

apps.name: Demon Tides Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the beginning area of this open world, expressive 3D platformer adventure! Meet the cast, find some juicy gear and compete with other players online!

apps.name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler Demo
apps.short_description: Open fantasy packs and build a party of four in this desktop idle auto-battler demo. Collect heroes and monsters, develop your party and help out with mouse-fire trails and typing-triggered fireballs. Try 20 waves and 25 mastery upgrades in a small window.

apps.name: Dirt Town Demo
apps.short_description: The demo for Dirt Town. Use incredible physics to create a road to find sand: Fell tree, move rocks, haul gravel! Find the hidden vehicle and build a jump!

apps.name: Doll Brawl Demo
apps.short_description: A demo for Doll Brawl, a character action roguelike. Battle enemies, and find different abilities to change your playstyle! Upgrade abilities in the skill tree to control the flow of your build, and take down increasingly tougher enemies with those upgrades!

apps.name: Dragon's Keep: Tidy up the Treasure! Demo
Dream Delver Demo
apps.short_description: Start your first shift in Dream Delver, a cozy-but-eerie 2D mining adventure. Dig through four zones, sell your haul, forge better tools and survive your bosses’ terrible advice as you descend toward the strange glow of the Sunken Aquifer.

apps.name: Effective Immediately Demo
apps.short_description:
All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint.
Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape.
Report for duty, Effective Immediately.

apps.name: EmyLiveShow Origins: Nia The Gamer Queen Demo
apps.short_description: Help the hot streamer girl to win the tournament and achieve sympathy of the sexy vampire queen.

apps.name: Eternal Strands Demo
apps.short_description: A realm of mystery, opportunity, danger, and wonder: the Enclave awaits.

apps.name: Final Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Final Factory blends factory building with a rich universe to explore. Build a vast network of automated space stations and command a massive fleet against the hostile local aliens. Discover new technologies and unlock the secrets of an ancient civilization as you explore an infinite cosmos.

apps.name: Four Lights, One Thief: A Shadow Puzzle Demo
Gaia Crisis Demo
apps.short_description: Enjoy an exclusive story in this trial version of Gaia Crisis! Play as Charlotte, a thief blessed with divine powers. With Dragonfae by her side, the duo travels back 2000 years to stop War Maiden's resurrection.

apps.name: GearGrit Demo
apps.short_description: A demo of GearGrit, a semi-open world action game inspired by games made in the 2000s

apps.name: Genetic Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Breed your strongest survivors and bend the rules of genetics to create the ultimate fighting bloodline. Discover powerful mutation combos, build synergistic teams, and evolve toward the genetic apex in this roguelite autobattler.

apps.name: Ghost Network : Dark Hacker Demo
apps.short_description: A cyberpunk hacking game set in Neon City. Take contracts from fixers, dive into building networks, steal the data, wipe your tracks and jack out before the trace finds you. Hack it from the terminal, or run it in a 3D dive.

apps.name: Glory Hole Barista Demo
apps.short_description: A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...

apps.name: Gretel & Hansel Demo
apps.short_description: Gretel & Hansel is a delightfully twisted exploration-adventure crafted entirely by hand in watercolor. Abandoned in a cursed forest, you play as Gretel, guiding her brother home while outwitting deadly traps, unraveling sinister puzzles, and escaping the clutches of a ravenous witch.

apps.name: Greyfall Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening of Greyfall's Story mode. Wake on the floor of a house in Millbrook, find the woman who wrote you a letter, earn a place among the survivors at Lakeside Camp, and stand with them when trouble comes to the gate. A first-person survival game in a sealed valley.

apps.name: Grobnopolis | Last Days Demo
apps.short_description: Grobnopolis is a slow, oppressive atmospheric horror experience where curiosity is both compass and curse. The sun is gone. The mines are bleeding. Walk the dying city of Huta-Grobno, tune into forbidden broadcasts and survive the last days of a world rotting under the clouds.

apps.name: Hayloop Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy farming and ranching sim where you grow a small plot into a thriving agricultural business. Plant and tend crops, raise animals, keep bees, process your harvest into valuable goods, open your shop, and automate your farm as it grows, all on your way to breeding prized horses.

apps.name: Hazard Levels Demo
apps.short_description: Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

apps.name: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill? Demo
Human-powered world Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game with a light tone and humor. Develop your colony, discover resources, build production, and unlock upgrades. Turn a lifeless planet into a thriving world and watch it transform step by step.

apps.name: Hungry Hoist Demo
apps.short_description: Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda! Hungry Hoist is a solo or co-op dungeon-crawler about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with.

apps.name: Ice Cream Demo
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a tropical island where new encounters, romantic meetings, and passionate dates await. Explore picturesque beaches, cozy cafés, luxurious hotels, and hidden corners of the island. Meet charming girls, spend time with them.

apps.name: Idle Pixel Battle Demo
apps.short_description:
Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression.
Build a team of heroes and watch them fight automatically through waves of monsters.

apps.name: Impossible Wonders Demo
apps.short_description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

apps.name: In Search of the Ice Pop Demo
apps.short_description: A short, nostalgic slice-of-life visual novel with a coming-of-age story about a forgotten ice pop and the girl who once felt like a big sister to you.

apps.name: Inconceivable Rat Endeavour Demo
apps.short_description:
Unconventional and genre-bending puzzler on a hexagonal grid. Rotate tiles to complete sewer style levels.
Constantly evolving mechanics.
Silly humour.

apps.name: Inside your hole Demo
apps.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer mini golf for up to 8 friends: tornadoes, black holes, falling TNT and a course editor to build your own holes. Plus a co-op story mode where you get reincarnated as a mini golf ball.

apps.name: Into The Depths Demo
apps.short_description: A classic grid & turn-based roguelike, procedurally generated dungeon crawler, aimed at re-creating the games of yesteryear.

apps.name: LANE-4: A Dystopian Programming Thriller Demo
apps.short_description: An open-ended programming game in which you optimise 4-core assembly code to maintain a 1990s alt-history dystopian megacity's infrastructure. Take jobs from middlemen with hidden agendas and uncover the chilling consequences of your "routine" fixes in this assembly language puzzle thriller.

apps.name: Learn To Rock Demo
apps.short_description: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

apps.name: Luna Plena Demo
apps.short_description:
"Read your enemy. Count every turn."
A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

apps.name: Makondes And The African Gods Demo
apps.short_description: Play as SUNA, a grandmother marked by war and guardian of a sacred Soulslike set in African mythology. The evil god KAO sleeps inside a mask on Makonde Mountain. His army has taken your grandson, and your blood is the key to free KAO. Save your village.

apps.name: Malhaar Demo
apps.short_description: A musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies.

apps.name: Manabies Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on an action adventure across floating islands where magical creatures, fast-paced arena battles, and an ever-growing flying base hide a unique twist: every battle is powered by real mathematics, helping you become smarter with every challenge.

apps.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion Demo
apps.short_description: A cosmic battle awaits! Get a first glimpse of Cosmic Invasion through this demo, choosing between 9 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy.

apps.name: Megabat Demo
apps.short_description: While in search of food, a fruit bat stumbles it's way through the ventilation system of a secret facility finding unique fruit that give special abilities. While in search of more fruit the bat must avoid traps and enemies. Will the bat be able to satiate it's hunger and escape with its life?

apps.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker Demo
apps.short_description: This is the free demo version! You're a shard of an Archangel. You have wings and a living sword that gets stronger each time you parry. You are Menes. Defeat gods and monsters, overcome hazards, uncover mysterious lore and explore surreal landscapes.

apps.name: MISTWAKE Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of MISTWAKE, a survival card game on a fogbound island. Explore seven early areas, gather supplies, manage hunger, thirst and illness, and build your first camp. The demo ends after camp preparations and your first lighthouse inspection.

apps.name: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions Demo
apps.short_description: A desktop companion idle cultivation RPG. Build a squad, fight automatically, collect treasure chests, and tune techniques and gear. Explore two maps with 18 standard nodes and two bosses, reach rank 19, and keep playing without a time limit.

apps.name: My Dirty Little Lake Demo
apps.short_description:
Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game.
With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear.
Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house.
Wildlife appreciates your work.

apps.name: Netshell Demo
apps.short_description: December 1996, Ohio. After his daughter goes to bed, a father goes down to the basement and keeps a hacker crew's machines running. Tonight one of them asks him for two clean boxes and a favor. A free standalone chapter of Netshell.

apps.name: Neural Spaceship Sandbox Demo
apps.short_description: Neural Spaceship Sandbox is a hybrid turn-based strategy and voxel sandbox with unlimited possibilities. Build custom spaceships, arm them to the teeth with advanced sci-fi weaponry, pilot them or hand the keys to our advanced AI, and then use them to conquer the galaxy / galaxies!

apps.name: Nightmere Demo
apps.short_description: The year is 1989. Amelia finds herself at AECC, a community center and pool, to solve a missing persons case. A bright and up-and-coming detective, this case will undoubtedly serve as the starting point for a long series of events that Amelia will carry with her into Nightmere years later.

apps.name: NOIR BLOOM Demo
apps.short_description: NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

apps.name: Not My Dad Demo
apps.short_description:
Something is stealing people's skin. And your dad might be one of the victims...
In Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game, complete your daily tasks while trying to live with the disturbing presence of "DAD".

apps.name: Oinkenomics Demo
apps.short_description: What if you took finance and tower defense, and added them together? Well, this is Oinkenomics, where you create pig towers to defend your piggy bank. Defend against the enemies of finance: bulls, bears, and the powerful black swan. And make sure to manage your stocks.

apps.name: One Billion Ducks Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

apps.name: Onikura Demo
apps.short_description: A frantic and challenging boss rush with options to customize your play style as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with attacks, specials, parries, and unique abilities.

apps.name: Operation HOPE - Tower Defense Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced Tower Defense set in a colorful retro-futuristic 1980s world. Face massive enemy swarms, build powerful defenses, and adapt to relentless assaults. Survive the final stand in Story Mode or test your limits in Roguelike Mode.

apps.name: PHASE ZERO Demo
apps.short_description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

apps.name: Pill & Chill Demo
apps.short_description: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no time limit, no score, and lots of satisfying little sounds.

apps.name: Plentiful Demo
apps.short_description: Plentiful is a Human Terrarium — Sculpt the land, redirect rivers, and grow food as you nurture your tribe. Guide your people through a perilous Stone Age and protect them from nature’s whims.

apps.name: Pub Brawl Demo
apps.short_description: Try Dave’s opening three stages in this British single-player beat ’em up. Learn the moves in the pub tutorial, chain combos and grab improvised weapons. A free taste of Ember Tech Games’ first game, before Beach Side Chaos.

apps.name: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army Demo
apps.short_description:
You can play from the beginning of the game up until shortly after the start of Episode 2.

Additionally, save data created in this demo can be carried over to the full version of the game.

apps.name: Riflehounds 1942
apps.short_description: 1-8 Player Action, Created By Jacob Boehm (Dulmari_Creations). The Prequel To Luke The Hybrid. Set In An Alternate History World War II. Upgrade and Customize Your Progression and Fight Against Rounds of Zombies.

apps.name: Scroll Control Demo
apps.short_description: You've applied to work at the Rune Bureau. Read each spell scroll’s rune, check the petitioner’s paperwork against the rulebook, and decide what gets licensed. Do well enough and the job is yours.

apps.name: Sea Of Rifts Demo
apps.short_description: In this naval sandbox RPG you assemble a motley crew of misfits and sail into a broken ocean to solve the mystery of why the world is falling apart. Engage in tense ship to ship combat and experience a new unique story every time you play. The helm is yours Captain.

apps.name: Shipolis Demo
apps.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game. Sail and explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Will you build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of this world?

apps.name: Shroud of Gloom Demo
apps.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

apps.name: Sidekick AI Demo
apps.short_description: A real-time anime sidekick who watches your game, voice-chats tips when you ask, and clips your best moments — all in-overlay, never alt-tab. Stream-safe, free to play.

apps.name: SolTarot Demo
apps.short_description: Turn low cards into big scores in SolTarot, a tarot-inspired solitaire roguelike. Combine Tarot powers, modify your cards, and bend the rules to overcome bosses that challenge your strongest combinations.

apps.name: Space Beads - The Sphincter Demo
apps.short_description: Grow a chain of beads, hang off ledges, fall, rewind and feed a very needy gate. The free demo has 3 tutorial chambers and 25 handcrafted puzzles from the start of the campaign. No timers, no ads. Keyboard or controller.

apps.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six players draft powerful spells and items, battle other mages, and fight through seven rounds of magical mayhem as the arena crumbles beneath their feet.

apps.name: Stonemachia Demo
apps.short_description:
Fight, Zefiro! Arm yourself with the power of chess and explore Medhelan, a land haunted by the Plague of Angels, in a dark action-adventure soulslike. 
Will you be able to return to Heaven?

apps.name: Sub Rosa Tournament Demo
apps.short_description: A 3D party game where every match revolves around one goal: steal the rival team's ball before they steal yours. Each character has its own abilities and playstyle. Team up, combine your skills, and outplay the other team in short, chaotic local-multiplayer matches.

apps.name: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager Demo
apps.short_description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and use your deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A unique hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

apps.name: Tales of Kathay Demo
apps.short_description: Tales of Kathay is a tactical turn-based RPG where every world is born from centuries of simulated history. Explore ruined kingdoms, join faction wars, craft your path through a living sandbox, and return generations later to see the mark your choices left behind.

apps.name: Tanks Endeavor Demo
apps.short_description: Tanks Endeavor was designed to be a family-friendly adventure puzzler. Customize the color of your tank and jump right into the fun. Play through several adventure levels that are unique and challenging as you progress through the game mode.

apps.name: Terminal Descent Demo
apps.short_description: Terminal Descent is a terminal-based mining incremental game. Upgrade drills, automate operations, smelt metals, and descend deeper. ASCII graphics with active/idle hybrid gameplay in your terminal.

apps.name: The Borderless: Cozy Island Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

apps.name: The Last Embrace Demo
apps.short_description: A young girl, a vampire and last of her kind, wakes up after a thousand years to a modern world. A story focused visual novel with adult elements. Mystery, betrayal, loss and violence await! Shape the future of the protagonist and the world itself!

apps.name: The Last Errant Demo
apps.short_description: The Last Errant is a challenging turn-based tactical deckbuilder. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, and outsmart your enemies in deeply tactical grid-based battles.

apps.name: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith Demo
apps.short_description: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith is a medieval blacksmith management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, and risk dangerous trades for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge alongside two wounded artisans. A 1-hour demo is available now!

apps.name: Town To City Demo
apps.short_description: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

apps.name: Unbroken Demo
apps.short_description: Brave the hostile lands in search of your goal. Forge your own path and discover the many secrets of the realm and the looming Township of Westfall. Unlock new abilities, perks and weapons. Soak in the atmosphere and head forth against all odds.

apps.name: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint Demo
apps.short_description: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

apps.name: Voidling Bound Demo
apps.short_description: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

apps.name: Weeny Wise Demo
apps.short_description:
A Co-Op Adventure, Puzzle-Platformer game.

apps.short_description: Every monster you defeat leaves something behind. Absorb its skills and spells, build your loadout, and watch your hero fight on their own. Fuse pieces in the Merge Laboratory and grow into something no class could ever be. A lighthearted idle auto-battler RPG, the sequel to Absorber.

apps.name: Adult Aura 2
apps.short_description: Restore the cosmos. In this immersive RPG adventure for PC and VR, wield magic and steel to heal sexy corrupted goddesses, dragons, demons, and fae. Journey through a shattered universe and uncover the mystery behind its destruction—your destiny is to bring it back to life.

apps.name: Adventures Online
apps.short_description: Tactical hex-grid fantasy RPG meets persistent multiplayer world. Six races, six classes, deep crafting, real-time exploration with shared or solo player shards. Free to play, free forever. No pay-to-win, ever.

apps.name: Aether Purge
apps.short_description: When games wear you out, unwind with a game. Aether Purge is a dark fantasy RPG told through still images and concise text. With simple, intuitive commands and turn-based combat, recruit companions and explore at your own pace—no rush, no quick reflexes required.

apps.name: AIKO: AI Girlfriend 3D Life Sim
apps.short_description: AIKO is a 3D slice-of-life dating sim where you build a real relationship with an AI companion who talks with you in real time, not scripted lines. Work, cook, furnish your home, and grow her personality through your choices. Deepen your bond, unlock intimacy, and marry her, Raise Children.

apps.name: Air Combat Legends
apps.short_description: Take command of a NATO squadron in an alternate 1990 where the USSR launches a full-scale invasion of Poland and East Germany. Choose your pilots, fighter jets, and fly critical combat missions in a dynamic, procedural campaign. A classic retro flight simulator inspired by 90s PC gaming legends!

apps.name: Alchemist's Codex
apps.short_description: Run a small alchemy shop and discover recipes by experiment. Grind, boil, distill and brew real ingredient properties, not fixed recipes. Take commissions, buy from the merchant, gather in your yard, and fill your Codex on the way to becoming a master alchemist.

apps.name: All A Broadside
apps.short_description: A free-form sandbox sailing RPG featuring a large open world, detailed sailing physics, and emergent NPC simulation. Make friends and enemies as you set sail with your goblin crew - but life at sea only ever ends in two ways... fortune or ruin.

apps.name: All Army Attack
apps.short_description: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

apps.name: All Our Broken Parts
apps.short_description: Experience a story-driven adventure game as a robot doctor. In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories. Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

apps.name: Alph Last Bastion
apps.short_description: The bug swarm is coming, and your bastion is the last thing standing in its way. Build a fortress of turrets anywhere on the battlefield, power it up, and hold the line against relentless hordes and monstrous bosses. Fall, upgrade your arsenal, and return stronger.

apps.name: ANDALAS : Realms of Eternal Lights
apps.short_description:
Join Rei, a boy fleeing his world to escape the grip of brain cancer, on a quest between dream and reality. 

Explore the vibrant lands of Andalas, incarn ancient figures and summon your pets to aid on your journey. Collect mysterious relics and uncover Andalas' secrets before it’s too late.

apps.name: Anomalies Files
apps.short_description: Anomalies Files is a 2D sci-fi horror action-adventure. Investigate sealed zones, recover terminal files, fight anomalous entities, and piece together the truth. Play solo or in local co-op for up to 6 players, with 2-player co-op especially recommended.

apps.name: Anseium
apps.short_description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

apps.name: AOG: Aircraft On Ground
apps.short_description: You are not an airline that sells tickets. You are the operator airlines hire: lease aircraft with crew, maintenance and insurance, paid per block hour. Sign contracts across a real map of the world, plan crews and checks round the clock, and grow your office and fleet.

apps.name: Ape Express
apps.short_description: A co-op delivery adventure for 1-4 apes. Pile into your battered pickup and haul explosive, ticking and occasionally alive cargo across a wild valley — over mountains, through caves and past things with teeth. No signature required.

apps.name: Arcana Clash
apps.short_description: A 2–6 player tarot card battler. Each of the 78 cards has two faces — upright and reversed — and you choose which one to unleash every time you play. Strike, curse, or turn the whole table upside down, and outlast your rivals before the Clock of Fate swallows everyone.

apps.name: Arcynth
apps.short_description: Awakened after 4,000 years, a fallen Archmage finds his world fractured into 14 rival kingdoms. Wield each kingdom’s magic and become any foe you defeat as you seek to reunite them. Infiltrate their wars and reshape the world's kingdom ladder as hundreds of thousands clash.

apps.name: Arkhe
apps.short_description: Action roguelike in a dark fantasy world. Solo or online co-op up to four. 52 biomes, 520 items, enemies that grow stronger every loop. Choose a portal. Survive the descent. Nothing below you is kind.

apps.name: Arteria
apps.short_description: Build roads, intersections, and tram lines. The city grows on its own along the roads you lay. Ease congestion and turn a village into a metropolis.

apps.name: Ascenfell
apps.short_description: A top-down pixel-art dungeon crawler for 1 to 3 players. Pick a Warrior, Ranger or Mage, survive waves of enemies, kill the boss on each floor and go deeper, with your own loot and a skill tree to build your hero.

apps.name: Ascent Surf
apps.short_description: Surf your way up a sprawling vertical map with CS-style movement. Keep your momentum as you link ramps, clear tricky jumps, and discover new areas on the way up. Miss a ramp and you can tumble back down the route you just climbed.

apps.name: Ash Company
apps.short_description: You run a mercenary company. Hire mercs, gear them up and send them into the ruins. Whatever they carry to the helicopter is your income. Spend it on wages and the base. Stay in the red too long and your mercs walk.

apps.name: Ashplate
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. The Emperor is dead, his throne stolen, and his sworn guard is hunted. Lead the Fallen Kiln through drowned swamps and moonlit hunting grounds, build a new deck every run, and fight your way back to the throne.

apps.name: Astral Phase
apps.short_description: Wake in your own home, only to discover your body is still lying in bed. Trapped outside yourself, explore a familiar house shared with beings from other dimensions, uncover the truth, and find a way back before reality collapses.

apps.name: Attkand
apps.short_description: ÅTTKAND is a minimalist color puzzle. Tap a chip to see the reaction wave around the board. Use the special chips to change the waves. Turn all the chips to the same color to win.

apps.name: Auto Battleships
apps.short_description:
A PvP auto battler where you build and upgrade a fleet of ships in a roguelike fashion! 
Scout your opponent's position before battle and prepare your board with the information gathered in mind.

apps.name: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

apps.name: Automation Station
apps.short_description: Explore a mysterious planet, harvest and refine resources, discover new technology, craft machines, and set up automated factories.

apps.name: BABKA-TERROR
apps.short_description: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.

apps.name: Backrooms: Negative Levels
apps.short_description:
A non-linear Backrooms experience focused on isolation, exploration, and uncertainty.
This is not a puzzle game — every level can lead to multiple destinations through unpredictable noclips.

apps.name: Ball of Goof
apps.short_description: A game you've never played before! Explore this world with up to 4 peeps (that's slang for people) in this comedically-driven open world sandbox by platforming through challenging challenges, unlock new abilities & uncover the delicious lore behind the ultimate question... What is a Ball of Goof?

apps.name: Banker: Tidy Up the Bank Vault
apps.short_description: Banker: Tidy Up the Bank Vault is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 16,000 scattered banknotes and coins. Put the vault back in order at your own pace, right down to the last coin.

apps.name: Banner Age
apps.short_description: Banner Age is a real-time strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Build your army, advance through the ages, and strengthen your forces through the talent tree. Battle an online opponent or a bot, defend your banner, and destroy the enemy’s.

apps.name: Barista Dream - Prologue
apps.short_description: Open your own cozy cafe for free. Brew every drink by hand, pour your own latte art, and read what customers post about you on an in-game social network.

apps.name: Barn to Orbit
apps.short_description: You’re a crew of alien cats whose saucer crashed near a sleepy town. By day, pose as farmers: grow crops and fill the mayor’s orders. By night, defend the farm from boars, wolves and a giant bear. Find your ship’s parts and fly home — in co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Base Matter
apps.short_description: A 3D material simulation sandbox for building machines, running experiments, and seeing what happens.

apps.name: Bazaar Below Zero
apps.short_description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you. Time to get to work! Mine ice, uncover frozen items and sell them to seals in this incremental co-op game for 1–4 players. Organize your bazaar, upgrade your tools and hire penguins. Explore the glacier’s secrets as you plot your escape.

apps.name: BELTFED
apps.short_description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.

apps.name: Bermuda Trial
apps.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore  the wonders and dangers of the procedurally generated maps of Bermuda Island.

apps.name: Between Dreams
apps.short_description: Tired of the same routine, you long for an exciting challenge. Climb higher through strange obstacles that seem to hold you back, as if they do not want you to wake from a dream. The higher you go, the more you wonder: is this world even real?

apps.name: Beyond Krukmore
apps.short_description: A turn-based dice-building roguelite where your weapons and spells are the dice you roll. Lead two heroes and a companion through a dark fantasy world, piece together powerful builds, and weigh the promise of better loot against the cost of one more fight.

apps.name: Bilingual Crosswords
apps.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

apps.name: Birds Are Not Real
apps.short_description: Create billions of robot birds to spy on the whole world in this active incremental clicker game.

apps.name: Bit by Bit
apps.short_description: Build a ridiculous game with your friends in minutes, then jump in and play it together. Draw the weapons & items, record the sound effects, draw the world, modify the rules and see what kind of cursed game your group creates.

apps.name: Black & White Bushido
apps.short_description: Black & White Bushido is a 1-4 player stealth-em-up arena brawl. Choose between the light and the shadow in three challenging game modes. Hide with camouflage, throw shurikens and drop smoke bombs to beat your friends locally or online.

apps.name: Black Rope Hell - Ximen Qing
apps.short_description: 《黑绳话·西门庆》是一款取材自《金瓶梅》与《水浒传》的中式暗黑互动叙事游戏。你将化身徘徊生死之间的西门庆，在阳谷城重走酒、色、财、气四道黑绳，于开放街区、亡宅冷房、雨伞铺与酒楼中探查旧债。每次选择都会改变业障、净魂与人物命运；收集三魂七魄，唤醒困于魂瓶中的李瓶儿。与潘金莲、王婆、武松及更多原著人物周旋，通过影像分支、物件回忆、AI人物自由对话与皮影共演，改写熟悉却未必注定的结局。试玩版开放第一结完整轮回。

apps.name: Blast Project
apps.short_description: A 2D action platformer inspired by the old greats like MegaMan X and Contra. Battle your way through the robot horde, with classic platformer levels and high speed shoot-em-up style stages

apps.name: Blockatro
apps.short_description: Blocatro is a score-focused tetromino roguelike about lining up blocky cats. Multiply your meows, build the board, create kittens and break curses. Every run brings a new build, a bigger board, and even more meows! The Catdex awaits.

apps.name: Blood Banner
apps.short_description: A world without limits. Strive for your own ambitions, achieve them in any way you deem fit. Go out and embark on an adventure, set out to build an empire, settle and hone your craft - it's up to you. Your new life is a legend waiting to be written...Spawn in a new world.

apps.name: Blood of the Tyrant
apps.short_description: Experience the weight of gladiatorial combat in this techno-Roman survivor where every weapon swing matters. Clone warrior seeks freedom through arena bloodshed in a cycle of power and corruption.

apps.name: Bone Jours Tale
apps.short_description: A cheerful skeleton pulls himself together, fights the dead who refuse to stay down, and tries to fit in with a village that is terrified of skeletons. Step one: get his arm back from the dog. A goofy action RPG about losing bits of yourself and making friends anyway.

apps.name: Boo! Boo! Train!
apps.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

apps.name: Boomside
apps.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

apps.name: Bosky
apps.short_description: Escape your school, avoid being seen by the teachers, and retrieve your backpacks and other things before getting outta here.

apps.name: Bots Reforged
apps.short_description: Build, battle, and rebuild your robot in a turn-based roguelite. Swap parts to change your abilities, combine relics, and manage energy as you choose your path through each run. Experiment with new builds and face powerful robotic enemies.

apps.name: Bow & Banner
apps.short_description: Live the campaign of a medieval longbowman. Hunt, scout, survive and fight in brutal battles as Kaden of Bracken, mastering archery and battlefield judgment across 14 chapters, while choices, wounds and failure shape a war story with 13 endings.

apps.name: Brickin' A Toy Town
apps.short_description: Smash cubes, build adorable houses, and create the toy town of your dreams! Enjoy satisfying destruction, unlock and level up all kinds of helpers and automations. Choose a charming theme or mix and match everything to make your little world truly yours!

apps.name: Brilliancy!!
apps.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

apps.name: Bubble Dropop
apps.short_description: Bubble Dropop is a cozy puzzle game about sorting pictures and words into categories. Drag to connect matching bubbles, then swipe down to collect them. Make every move count as you solve puzzles across a variety of levels, unlock colorful backgrounds, and find your own relaxing rhythm.

apps.name: Bunny Tower
apps.short_description: Jump higher than ever! Bunny Tower is a fast arcade platformer: climb an endless tower through 8 worlds, grab coins and unlock 35+ skins with unique abilities. The higher you go, the faster it gets. One mistake and it's over. How high can you go?

apps.name: Busty Angel Paradise
apps.short_description: Hand out the divine punishment of ultimate pleasure to all 20 superbly stacked heroines! Win (or lose) sex battles in this RPG, and enjoy larger-than-life H-scenes, every one animated!

apps.name: Caldera County
apps.short_description: Your callsign is Air Attack 51. Circling overhead, your job is to call in aerial drops and direct ground crews against a fire that spreads with the wind, terrain and fuel. You must hold the line and protect every structure you can, but keeping people safe (including your units) is top priority.

apps.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Zombies
Captain's Wake
apps.short_description: Loot, level, legend! Captain's Wake is a pirate action RPG on a cutthroat sea, where rival captains level up, loot and hunt just like you. Every ship has a captain with a fortune to chase and a long memory. Will you be friend or foe? Chart your own course and become a legendary pirate.

apps.name: Captive Lily
apps.short_description: In this roguelike adventure, you awaken with no memory in a deadly dungeon built to contain demon kin. Fight through ever-changing floors, meet mysterious heroines, and build bonds that unlock powerful skills. Return stronger after every defeat and uncover the secrets buried deep below.

apps.name: Car? What Car?
apps.short_description: Smash cars in the parking lot before the police arrive. Build your own cars from the loot, paint them and sell them. Grow your skill tree, open sticker chests and pay off your uncle's debt to the mafia. The Don doesn't like to wait.

apps.name: Caramba Caballeros
apps.short_description: Caramba Caballeros is a first-person pirate roguelike for 1–4 players. Explore islands and hunt for treasure by day. Defend your ship from enemy waves by night. Battle other pirates in a battle royale, solo or in teams, with matchmaking and custom lobbies.

apps.name: CARD GAME HUB
apps.short_description: The ultimate collection of classic card games to enjoy solo or with friends. Relive the excitement of Truco, master Chinchón, challenge the dealer in Blackjack, and unwind with Solitaire in a digital experience designed to discover, learn, and master both Spanish and French decks.

apps.name: Card Thunder
apps.short_description: Select cards from a 5x5 grid, stack powerful boosters and perks, and outscore escalating target scores in this spatial poker roguelike.

apps.name: Cardboard Cowboy
apps.short_description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

apps.name: Cardboard Tanks
apps.short_description: Co-op tank roguelite for 1–4 players. Blast through a fully destructible world, online or on the couch.

apps.name: CARRRDS
apps.short_description: CARRRDS is a multiplayer pirate card game. Race your ship, sabotage the other captains, and try to be the first one home with the treasure.

apps.name: Carts & Coins
apps.short_description: Your father left you a cart and 1,000 coins of debt. Haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack your cart like a puzzle, and trade your way across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run. Buy low, sell high, survive the road.

apps.name: Casino Dealer Simulator
apps.short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

apps.name: Castaway Collection
apps.short_description: Three classic Flash games return in one collection. Raise loyal pets, battle monsters, discover powerful equipment, explore mysterious islands, and build elemental defenses across the complete Castaway series, with more than 60 Steam achievements to unlock.

apps.name: Casus Foederis: 1815
apps.short_description: Europe, 1815. Every court watches the others. Grow too fast and the powers unite against you; break your word and no one stands by you. Lead one of twelve powers to 1871 — by recognition, by congress or by force, if you can pay the price. Turn-based, single-player.

apps.name: Cell Eats City
apps.short_description: A cursor-driven incremental game about one escaped cell. You steer, it eats: microbes, a research lab, a technician's flat, then a whole city. Mutate between short rounds, break every barrier and grow from a speck under the microscope to the size of a city. Then do it again as five other microbes.

apps.name: Cell Gap
apps.short_description: This is a cell survival and construction game. The player initially starts as a perfect hexagonal cell and expands the cell population by collecting and transporting various particles to build themselves. They engage in battles with other organisms and gradually develop into a cellular empire.

apps.name: Chechelevo Mainland
apps.short_description: Chechelevo Mainland is a procedurally generated sandbox game focused on resource gathering. Carve your path through the landscape, upgrade your robot, uncover hidden stashes, and build your own underground world, progress is saved locally, and every world is unique thanks to seed-based generation.

apps.name: CheckWild
apps.short_description: CheckWild is a spatial roguelike. Place directional symbols on the board, pair them with abilities you collect along the way, and build up your score to defeat monsters!

apps.name: Cheese Panic
apps.short_description: An asymmetric co-op stealth action game: one player is the Cat, up to four are mice. Raid a house, a factory and a dungeon for food, distract the predator and haul the loot together before you get caught. Silly physics, proximity voice chat and random events in every match.

apps.name: Chess Variant: Chase The King
apps.short_description: In Chase The King, both kings start with no pieces and earn them by making aggressive moves. Each piece has a cost and you can throw out all the old opening moves. Challenge yourself through 100 Elo-rated difficulty levels offline, or chase real opponents online.

apps.name: Chill Chess
apps.short_description: Relax, strategize, and master chess in a sleek 3D sci-fi world. Play against friends or other players online, or challenge smart AI.

apps.name: Choking Hazard
apps.short_description: Build giant toy sets with up to 3 friends, online or split-screen. One enormous pop-up manual, no adult supervision. Argue over step 8 together, or take it slow on your own. Finish a set and watch it spring to life. In Creative mode, build your own sets and share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: Cinema Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: 🎬 Schedule movies, sell tickets, serve snacks, customize your theater, play arcade mini-games, and befriend adorable cats. Turn your cinema into the ultimate entertainment destination, alone or with friends! 🍿

apps.name: Clanker Town
apps.short_description: You called your smart home a clanker one too many times. Now millions of robot appliances want your trailer. Hold the yard in a first-person horde shooter, sell their scrap off Dale's tailgate, and grow one nail gun into hubcaps, Black Cats, a propane slingshot and a lawnmower minigun.

apps.name: Classic Shooter Arena
apps.short_description: Build your own arenas and fight inside SERAPH's combat simulation. Classic Shooter Arena combines fast-paced first-person shooting with a map maker, letting you shape the battlefield while a cold, sarcastic AI judges every round.

apps.name: Classroom 3B
apps.short_description: Investigate an abandoned Indian school where the truth was buried — literally. Manage a failing power system, monitor live CCTV feeds, and piece together a tragedy through documents, audio logs, and authentic Hindi work in this psychological horror investigation.

apps.name: Click through Earth
apps.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

apps.name: Clicky Keys
apps.short_description:
Clicky Keys is a tower defense game where your keyboard is the battlefield.
Every key activates a weapon. Fight off enemies and make the right upgrade choices to survive.
Can you reach day 20?

apps.name: CLT Supermarket
apps.short_description: You are Xxx, a security guard forced to work the night shift. Unfortunately for you, boredom is the least of your worries at CLT SUPERMARKET. Survive, fight back, and uncover the truth behind what’s happening in this fast-paced action-horror adventure as you face the horrors of both the workplace.

apps.name: Coffee & Fox
apps.short_description:
Manage your café, meet new friends, and serve unique drinks as new stories unfold every day in Coffee & Fox!
Can you handle everything this place has to offer?

apps.name: Coffee Buns
apps.short_description: Coffee Buns is a transformation visual novel set in the world of Mice Tea. Leonardo Bianco is a barista getting used to living in a world where a magical tea can turn you into a furry, and when he gets his own chance to try it he's thrust into an erotic, gender-bending journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: Cold Case: Unfinished Sentences
apps.short_description:
Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. 
The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. 
Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Confide
apps.short_description: Create, customize, and interact. A deep character creator with hundreds of morphs, full outfit design, and control over nearly every detail down to tattoo and accessory placement, plus an optional conversation mode that runs entirely offline on your own machine.

apps.name: Coq++
apps.short_description: Build mathematical proofs like circuits. Connect facts and rules, break down puzzles, and turn the theorems you prove into tools for your next challenge. Start with the simplest connections, and unlock new proof blocks as you go.

apps.name: CorruptedZ
apps.short_description: Lead a band of survivors through a valley the dead have taken. Build a colony from salvage, keep your people fed, warm and sane, and hold your walls against the infected and raiders. Raise children, bury your dead and take back the town of Blackwater. Single-player colony survival.

apps.name: Cosmicon Plague
apps.short_description: Fight against the evil bio-organic space armada known as the "Union" in this retro inspired , action packed horizontal shmup.

apps.name: Couch Potato
apps.short_description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

apps.name: CRASH THE PARTY
apps.short_description: Blend in. Bluff the Guards. CRASH THE PARTY is a chaotic multiplayer game where Destroyers disguise as Guests, Guards or Statues create distractions and destroy the party while avoiding capture. Guards spot suspicious players and hunt down the hidden Destroyers before chaos takes over!

apps.name: Crossbloom
apps.short_description: Defend the last gardens from waves of mutant pests in a colorful roguelite tower defense. Crossbreed living plants, expand the battlefield block by block, and shape powerful botanical builds that evolve with every run.

apps.name: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
apps.short_description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

apps.name: D-JT: Don the Jurassic Tyrant
apps.short_description: When Election meet Extinction! Dinos ripped through space to crush President Don's election, and his Plan? Invade Dino Isekai, grab the oil, and turn every dino into an immigrant voter! Place your army, press start, and watch thousands clash in this glorious chaos mass-battle strategy game!

apps.name: Dark School
apps.short_description: Receiving that letter was like a dream come true to you.. You are a dark-hunter! At this school, you'll learn to grow your supernatural powers, and hunt down horrible Boss Monsters! .. But.. You just can't help but feel like.. Something is a bit oFf? '.

apps.name: Darkwood 2
apps.short_description: Roam freely around the scorched deserts of a dying sea as you secure resources and explore the mysteries of Darkwood. But beware nightfall – seek shelter, shore up your defenses, and pray for the morning light as the horrors of the world hunt the ill-prepared.

apps.name: DEATCoreBattle
apps.short_description: Hold your last bastion against an enemy with a plan. Build your economy, wall off the routes and place your defenders between waves, while an Invader Director reads how you play and picks the strategy that hurts most.

apps.name: Deep Clean
apps.short_description: A co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. You're a crew of space janitors: scrub stations after "incidents" and find out what roams the halls and how to survive it. There are no instructions: try everything, log your discoveries in the glossary and piece together the truth.

apps.name: Deep Pockets
apps.short_description: Deep Pockets is an incremental inventory management game where every ore you mine gets dropped into your pockets as a physics object. Dig deep, ferry minerals in your pockets, and get rich! But be sure to not take more than you can carry.

apps.name: DEFCON 89
apps.short_description: OLD-SCHOOL ZOMBIES ARE BACK. Survive endless rounds solo or in 4-player co-op in a Cold War nightmare set in 1989. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, explore sinister maps, find secret weapons and unravel each map's hidden main story. How long can you last?

apps.name: Definitely Safe
apps.short_description: Put rockets together from scrap parts, pack the powder, cut the fuse and see what happens. Film every flight. Upload your footage, chase views, and climb the charts. Totally legal. Definitely safe.

apps.name: Defrost Forbidden
apps.short_description: The year is 4150. You discover an old cryo facility. The sleepers are still inside, but their names are gone. Cross-reference interview tapes, newspapers and notices to identify each one and fill in their records. With every name you restore, more of what happened here comes to light.

apps.name: DELTA // SURGE
apps.short_description: In DELTA // SURGE you build an overpowered fighter and blast through waves of enemy fleets and bosses. Choose weapons and upgrades during each run, then spend your earnings on permanent upgrades and unlock powerful cards. Come back stronger and see how far your next build takes you.

apps.name: Delta Particles
apps.short_description: Delta Particles – is a total conversion mod for HL. You're playing as a technical engineer of complex "Delta Base" Nick Farrell. Unfortunately, the protagonist was in the wrong place at the wrong time, as an experiment at the Black Mesa Research Facility resulted in a resonance cascade.

apps.name: DENIED: Zarya-9
apps.short_description: Winter 1986. Night shift at highway checkpoint ZARYA-9. Check papers, query plates on a green-phosphor terminal, and approve, deny, detain or report. The pay is per car. The heat bill is due. And the registry says this car was scrapped in 1972.

apps.name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
apps.short_description: An idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop. Spend the gold your party earns on fantasy packs, collect hero, monster and even boss cards, and field a party of four. They fight on their own while you work. Sweep your mouse across the field to leave a trail of fire.

apps.name: Dice Showdown
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy meets Roguelike adventure! Enjoy a mix of luck and tactics. Build a unique skill set, battle various enemies, discover powerful devices, and save the world!

apps.name: Die Rich
apps.short_description: Fight to clear the emperor’s debt in Die Rich, a gladiator action roguelite for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Cut through swarms, draft weapon upgrades and win the crowd. Conquer four arenas, explore the Wilds and claim seals on your path to freedom.

apps.name: Dignaut
apps.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

apps.name: DigRogue
apps.short_description: “DigRogue” is a solo-play mining 3D roguelite. Stranded on an unknown planet with minimal supplies, you must mine resources and gather enemy materials to upgrade your gear. Defeat the planet’s bosses, using their unique organs to upgrade your spaceship, and begin your long journey back to Earth.

apps.name: Dikec Clicker
apps.short_description: Not one of those scammy clickers. It's a legit old-school clicker, themed around one of the world's fastest-growing memes, DIKEC! Take a deep breath, lock-in, and get ready to smash some records!

apps.name: Dinover
apps.short_description: A prehistoric 2D pixel art sandbox where you face dinosaurs and other mysterious creatures. Craft weapons, fight giant bosses, and expand your survival abilities. Explore jungles and caves, mine ore underground, craft better tools, build a base, and upgrade your outfit to complete the clan’s trials.

apps.name: Directive: Deforest
apps.short_description: You've been given one directive: clear the forest. Chop trees, sell the wood, upgrade your axe, build drones and carrier bots, and push deeper into stranger woods. Every tree you fell makes the next one easier. Don't ask why the forest has to go.

apps.name: Dittomatic
apps.short_description: A turn-based photocopier roguelike about copying the copy of a copy. Box up stamps, copy them and press them back onto the page. Copies grow stronger, matches fuse and mismatches misprint. Build a page worth printing, then watch the score cascade past quota.

apps.name: Doll Brawl
apps.short_description: Introducing Doll Brawl, a character action roguelike. Battle enemies, and find different abilities to change your playstyle! Upgrade abilities in the skill tree to control the flow of your build, and take down increasingly tougher foes with those upgrades!

apps.name: Don Dim Dum
apps.short_description: Don Dim Dum is a challenging puzzle game, brain-teaser, with easy and hard levels, move Don one step at a time and he will move until stopped. Challenge your mind with this labyrinth-like puzzle game!

apps.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
apps.short_description: Welcome to Don Pepe's hit game show! Grab your water balloons and outsmart your rivals in this explosive, fast-paced party brawler for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Don't Burn Out!
apps.short_description: A block-pushing puzzle game in corporate hell, where you must confront your boss and escape the soul-draining workplace before you literally burn out. Solve over 100 handcrafted & unique puzzles that will require you to think strategically, with each step bringing you closer to flames!

apps.name: Don't Feed the Zombie
apps.short_description: Extraction survival in a dead city, seen from above. Raid the Zone for gear, fight players and the infected, and get out alive — or lose everything you carried in. Every meal they take makes the virus smarter. Don't feed the zombie.

apps.name: Don't Kill Them All
apps.short_description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster.  Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

apps.name: Don't Let Him Cook
apps.short_description: A co-op cooking comedy for 1–3 players. Uncle is cooking the finale of a live TV show, and you, his family, make sure the judges finally reject his plate: swap his salt for sugar, fiddle with his burners, make off with his pans — just don’t let him catch you.

apps.name: Dont Wake Dad
apps.short_description: Sneak, steal, and escape without waking Dad! Play solo or with up to three friends in this tense, funny stealth game. Dodge traps, hide in cupboards, upgrade your skills, and reach the getaway van before it leaves. One more valuable could cost you everything.

apps.name: Draftmaster 3
apps.short_description:
Racing is a team sport, now you're the whole team.

Seamlessly hop between roles across the race weekend, driving the car, running the strategy, through to changing the tires and scouting the field for new talent and sponsors. 

Help a friend with online co-op play, coming soon to PC and Mobile.

apps.name: DREADMINER: Millions Below
apps.short_description: Mine the depths. Expand your network. Turn the caverns into a killing ground. Build a fragile foothold into a roaring battery in this gothic steampunk sci-fi tower defense RTS, and take command when the swarm pushes your defenses to the limit.

apps.name: Drellnathor
apps.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

apps.name: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
apps.short_description:
This is a game about the painstaking and gradual process of building a fully functional, 
resource-harvesting, and self-defending base in the desert from scratch. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the unknown deserts!

apps.name: Duskwarden
apps.short_description: Co-op survival action RPG for up to 6 players. Hunt, forge, and cook your way across a shattered fantasy archipelago, take down colossal Wardens, and rekindle the Lumen before the world loses its next dawn.

apps.name: ECC: REDLINE
apps.short_description: ECC: REDLINE is a brand-new, self-developed extreme-sports tactical shooter from NetEase Games. It is faster, smoother, and more forgiving: every movement choice and every shot can turn the tide.

apps.name: Echoes of Durinn
apps.short_description: Survive Ringval Wilds in a fantasy survival crafting game. Gather resources, build your base, tame and breed creatures, and explore dangerous biomes and dungeons. Tribe warfare and base raiding are planned for online PvP.

apps.name: Echograve
apps.short_description: You have been appointed warden of an underground complex. Check documents and identify dangerous citizens by their behavior and sounds. Decide whom to let through the airlock and defend against threats from below. Until your shift ends, their lives — and yours — are your responsibility.

apps.name: Election Rigging for Dummies
apps.short_description: Run a shady consulting firm hired to rig elections in made-up countries. Bribe institutions, pull criminal operatives from loot boxes, flood the map with bots and fake scandals, and win before anyone notices. Satirical turn-based strategy, solo or with up to 4 players.

apps.name: Elvenbless: Sexcesion Festival
apps.short_description: Win the match. STRIP your opponent. Take their Aether. In Elvenbless, every card-game victory can end in BED 🔥 🥵 The energy you collect lets you change sex, develop your Chakras, and unlock new SEXUAL possibilities 👅💦 You have only five days until Ascension, so don't waste a second ⏳

apps.name: Encroaching Shadows
apps.short_description: Explore a deserted sanatorium and survive the presence stalking its dark hallways in this atmospheric, retro-inspired first-person survival horror game with an uncanny liminal feel.

apps.name: Erehwon
apps.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

apps.name: Evil Frenzy Arena
apps.short_description: Evil Frenzy Arena is a 2D pixel art arena roguelite with bullet hell and frenetic chaos. Survive waves, unlock abilities and craft wild builds from weapons, evolutions and prototypes. It starts slow, then the enemies and bosses turn the arena into pure frenzy.

apps.name: Exchange Alley
apps.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

apps.name: FACULA
apps.short_description: Explore, Build, and Fight in this handcrafted solar system with many secrets to discover and enemies to defeat! FACULA is an open world exploration and base-building focused game where you fight monsters and survive on an array of unknown worlds.

apps.name: Fate's Masquerade
apps.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

apps.name: Faunaville
apps.short_description: Care for animals, build lasting bonds, and learn new abilities from your companions in Faunaville, a cozy farming RPG. Grow crops, cook meals, fish, help the townsfolk, and explore alongside an animal buddy in turn-based battles. All at your own pace. No stamina bar, no day clock, do what you want.

apps.name: Felix's bad dream
apps.short_description: Felix's bad dream is an adventure game about Felix, who wakes up in an unusual place for him and will continue to explore it.

apps.name: Fever
apps.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

apps.name: Fifth Tier
apps.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

apps.name: Final Kastle
apps.short_description: Orc hordes march on your castle wave after wave. Man the cannons, call down lightning, freeze the field and fight on the walls, alone or with up to 16 players online, in a third-person castle defense shooter with a living castle to explore.

apps.name: Fire Buller
apps.short_description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

apps.name: Fished Out
apps.short_description: Fish, flee, and gamble your way to quota in this 1-4 player roguelike. Fight every catch, haul it aboard, avoid demonic beasts, and make it back to the ship with just enough time to bet it all at the casino. Miss quota and the sea takes every coin. One wrong cast could cost everything.

apps.name: Five Shifts at Zlata’s
apps.short_description: Five Shifts at Zlata's is an atmospheric horror night-shift simulator where you play as a security mechanic in a family restaurant hiding dark secrets. Monitor cameras, manage power, restart the generator, and keep the animatronics-mascots away. Survive five shifts… if you can.

apps.name: Flame, Forest & Flood
apps.short_description: Flame, Forest & Flood is a cozy, intuitive strategy that feels like a board game. Play solo or with friends and between matches, grow your own garden sanctuary, a quiet escape that blooms as you play.

apps.name: Fluffkin Grove
apps.short_description: A cosy pixel idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Hatch collectible Fluffkins, assign them to work buildings, and watch four little worlds grow while you do other things.

apps.name: Flush Draw
apps.short_description: Flush Draw puts the control in your hands. Literally. Cash out every hand and stack the deck with upgrades in a focused, hour-long sprint to finally draw a flush, then keep drawing to find all 8 endings. But be warned: the odds are against you.

apps.name: Football Story
apps.short_description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

apps.name: Forever World Craft
apps.short_description: Build a world together, then watch it come to life. Forever World Craft is a multiplayer world-building sandbox where you shape the land, build settlements and create a home for NPCs who work, rest and live in the world you make.

apps.name: Forgotten Fluff
apps.short_description: Forgotten Fluff is a mysterious escape the room game set inside an abandoned circus. Solve puzzles, help trapped animals and slowly uncover the truth about the strange place you've awakened in. Can you escape?

apps.name: FOSSILE LOADING
apps.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

apps.name: FrameWork
apps.short_description: Your desktop IS the puzzle. Drag, stack, and arrange real OS windows to guide a marble to the goal. Physics meets window management in a puzzle game that turns your entire screen into a playground. Features a level editor, Steam Workshop, and speedrun leaderboards.

apps.name: FreightLines
apps.short_description: Build a freight empire in a living miniature world. Link towns by road, rail, sea and air, and watch every delivery shift the market. Play Cozy to unwind, or go Simulation for loans, seasons and rival buyouts.

apps.name: Froginko
apps.short_description: A cozy pachinko roguelike. Bounce bugs through a pond full of frogs, merge frogs into bigger frogs, and get your best score in Challenge Mode, where one drop decides your place on the leaderboard.

apps.name: FrogMog
